description: End-to-end quality control and assurance workflow for 5G UDM (Unified Data Management) configurations and subscriber data, including snapshotting, validation, testing, rollout, monitoring, and rollback.

udm_config_version_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific UDM configuration version in QA.

udm_config_snapshot_id.description: Identifier for a full or partial snapshot of UDM configuration/state taken for QA or rollback.

qa_session_id.description: Identifier for a QA session grouping validations, tests, and approvals on a particular UDM configuration version.

test_suite_id.description: Identifier for a predefined or ad-hoc test suite to validate UDM behavior and data consistency.

test_run_id.description: Identifier for a specific execution of a test suite within a QA session.

approval_request_id.description: Identifier for a change approval request associated with a QA session and UDM configuration version.

rollout_plan_id.description: Identifier for a rollout plan that defines how a UDM configuration version is deployed to environments or regions.

environment.description: Execution environment for UDM configuration or tests.

subscriber_selector.description: Selector describing which subscriber set to sample or check in QA.

sample_size.description: Number of subscribers to randomly sample if applicable.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: create_udm_qa_session
functions.description: Initialize a new QA session for a specific UDM configuration version, including scope and target environments.

udm_config_version_id.description: Target UDM configuration version under test.

base_environment.description: Primary environment where QA validation will be executed.

target_environments.description: List of environments this QA session aims to certify.

scope.description: Defines functional scope and data coverage for QA.

initiated_by.description: User or system identifier initiating the session.

change_ticket.description: Associated change request or JIRA ticket.

functions.returns: New QA session details including qa_session_id, initial status, and derived scope summary.

functions.name: create_udm_config_snapshot
functions.description: Create a snapshot of current UDM configuration and optionally subscriber subsets for rollback and comparison.

qa_session_id.description: QA session within which the snapshot is created.

include_runtime_state.description: Whether to include active session/context state for comparison.

functions.returns: Snapshot metadata including udm_config_snapshot_id, captured scopes, and size metrics.

functions.name: run_static_udm_config_validation
functions.description: Execute static validation checks on a UDM configuration version (schemas, referential integrity, policy rules).

validation_profile.description: Profile defining which rule sets to apply.

rule_overrides.description: Allow selective enable/disable of validation rules.

functions.returns: Validation report summarizing rule results, severity distribution, and blocking issues if any.

functions.name: prepare_udm_test_dataset
functions.description: Prepare or clone a test dataset in a target environment for dynamic UDM behavioral tests.

anonymization.description: Controls anonymization of PII in cloned datasets.

fields.description: Specific fields to anonymize (if not full_synthetic).

data_mutators.description: Optional data mutation rules for boundary and negative testing.

reuse_existing_dataset_id.description: Optional ID of existing prepared dataset to reuse instead of creating new one.

functions.returns: Details of created or reused dataset including dataset_id, size, anonymization summary, and mutation profile.

functions.name: create_udm_test_suite
functions.description: Create or register a UDM test suite containing test cases for functional, performance, and regression checks.

test_cases.description: Definition of test cases within the suite.

functions.returns: Registered test suite details including test_suite_id and case counts by priority/category.

functions.name: run_udm_test_suite
functions.description: Execute a test suite against a prepared dataset and UDM configuration in a specific environment.

dataset_id.description: Identifier of the prepared dataset to use.

functions.returns: Test run information including test_run_id, initial state, scheduled workers, and estimated completion time.

functions.name: get_udm_test_run_status
functions.description: Get real-time status and partial results for a specific UDM test run.

case_filters.description: Optional filters to limit returned case summaries.

functions.returns: Current state of the test run with progress, metrics overview, and optionally aggregated case-level results.

functions.name: request_udm_config_approval
functions.description: Create an approval request for promoting a UDM configuration version based on QA results.
functions.returns: Approval request details including approval_request_id, current approval status, and pending approvers.

functions.name: plan_udm_config_rollout
functions.description: Create a phased rollout plan for deploying a UDM configuration version across environments and regions.

phases.description: List of rollout phases (ignored for big_bang, auto-derived if empty for canary_gradual).

items.description: Named criteria or metrics conditions that must be met to start the phase.
Conditions that must be met to mark the phase as successful.

functions.returns: Rollout plan details including rollout_plan_id, normalized phases, and derived monitoring thresholds.

functions.name: execute_udm_rollout_phase
functions.description: Start or advance a specific rollout phase for a UDM configuration version and monitor initial health.

override_safeguards.description: Whether to bypass certain automatic safeguards (requires justification).

justification.description: Required when overriding safeguards or aborting.

functions.returns: Phase execution status including updated phase state, any blocked conditions, and initial health indicators.

functions.name: monitor_udm_rollout_health
functions.description: Continuously or on-demand evaluate health indicators for an ongoing UDM rollout across phases.
functions.returns: Aggregated health metrics, threshold breaches, and recommendations (continue, pause, rollback) for the specified scope.

functions.name: rollback_udm_config
functions.description: Rollback UDM configuration and optionally subscriber sample data using a previously created snapshot.
functions.returns: Rollback job details including status, estimated impact, and, for dry runs, a change summary.

functions.name: retry_udm_test_or_rollout_step
functions.description: Retry a failed UDM QA test run or rollout phase step with optional parameter adjustments.

override_parameters.description: Context-specific overrides for the retried operation.

items.description: IDs of specific non-critical validations to relax for retry.

functions.returns: New or updated execution context (new test_run_id or phase attempt id) and adjusted parameters used for retry.

functions.name: udm_qa_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import udm qa entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: udm_qa_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many udm qa entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: udm_qa_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many udm qa entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: udm_qa_bulk_export
functions.description: Export udm qa entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: udm_qa_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across udm qa entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: udm_qa_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for udm qa events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: udm_qa_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for udm qa notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: udm_qa_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more udm qa entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: udm_qa_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to udm qa on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: udm_qa_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a udm qa operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: udm_qa_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending udm qa change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: udm_qa_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending udm qa approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: udm_qa_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a udm qa entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: udm_qa_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a udm qa entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: udm_qa_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a udm qa entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: udm_qa_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a udm qa entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: udm_qa_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for udm qa activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: udm_qa_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a udm qa view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: udm_qa_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to udm qa entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: udm_qa_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given udm qa payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: udm_qa_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a udm qa entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: udm_qa_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a udm qa entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
